h:
此 ComfyUI 工作流程旨在使用 Flux 模型生成详细的、角色驱动的图像。工作流程以动态提示系统、强大的图像生成和先进的采样技术为中心。它包括：

  1. 通量模型积分：

    • 利用特定于 Flux 的组件，例如VAE加载器, 双CLIP加载器, TripleCLIPLoader, 和UNET加载器用于稳健的模型加载和操作。

    • 支持多种 LoRA 模型以增强风格，包括微调纹理和戏剧性的灯光效果。

  2. 提示系统：

    • 包括用于指定预期样式、场景细节和质量的可自定义文本字段。

    • 具有“随机提示”节点，其中包含角色特征和描述等预定义选项（例如，以特定风格重新想象劳拉·克劳馥等标志性角色）。

  3. 图像生成管道：

    • Multiple samplers and schedulers work together to create high-quality latent outputs.

    • Includes advanced upscaling (CR高档形象）和用于实时监控结果的预览节点。

  4. 动态调节：

    • 包含像这样的节点调节连接和CLIPTextEncodeFlux实现灵活的多层图像调节。

  5. 用户指南和注意事项：

    • 提供嵌入式注释，指导用户在何处放置通配符，并提示与工作流程无缝集成。

    • 有关设置和使用管道特定元素的清晰说明。

  6. 预览与比较：

    • 集成用于实时可视化的预览节点和用于评估生成输出的质量的图像比较器。

  7. 可配置的输出：

    • 量身定制，以产生具有高纹理保真度和逼真的人物特征的精美视觉效果，同时保持艺术魅力

o.en:
This ComfyUI workflow is designed for generating detailed, character-driven imagery with Flux models. The workflow is centred around a dynamic prompting system, robust image generation, and advanced sampling techniques. It includes:

  1. Flux Model Integration:

    • Utilizes Flux-specific components likeVAELoader, DualCLIPLoader, TripleCLIPLoader, andUNETLoaderfor robust model loading and operation.

    • Supports multiple LoRA models to enhance styles, including fine-tuned textures and dramatic lighting effects.

  2. Prompting System:

    • Includes customizable text fields for specifying prospective styles, scene details, and quality.

    • Features a "Random Prompt" node with predefined options like character traits and descriptions (e.g., iconic characters like Lara Croft reimagined in a specific style).

  3. Image Generation Pipeline:

    • Multiple samplers and schedulers work together to create high-quality latent outputs.

    • Includes advanced upscaling (CR Upscale Image) and preview nodes for live monitoring of results.

  4. Dynamic Conditioning:

    • Incorporates nodes likeConditioningConcatandCLIPTextEncodeFluxto enable flexible, multi-layer conditioning of images.

  5. User Guidance and Notes:

    • Provides embedded notes to guide users on where to place wildcards and prompts for seamless integration with the workflow.

    • Clear instructions for setting up and using specific elements of the pipeline.

  6. Preview and Comparison:

    • Integrates preview nodes for real-time visualization and an image comparer for assessing the quality of generated outputs.

  7. Configurable Outputs:

    • Tailored to produce polished visuals with high textural fidelity and lifelike character traits, while maintaining artistic charm
